title: Magnesium Reborn
features:
ESP Features
ESP Enabled - Master toggle for all ESP
Box ESP - Show boxes around players
Name ESP - Show player names
Tracer ESP - Lines from screen to players
Health Bar - Visual health bars
Show Distance - Display distance in meters
Show Health Number - Show exact HP values
ESP Settings
Text Size - Adjust ESP text size (8-24)
Box Thickness - Line width for boxes (1-5)
Tracer Thickness - Line width for tracers (1-5)
ESP Transparency - Visibility control (0-1)
Max Distance - ESP render distance
ESP FPS - Performance vs quality
ESP Colors
Box Color - Customize box colors
Tracer Color - Customize tracer colors
Health Bar Color - Health bar color options
Text Color - ESP text color
Aimbot Features
Aimbot Enabled - Master aimbot toggle
Aimbot FOV - Field of view circle
FOV Size - Adjust aimbot radius
FOV Color - Customize FOV circle
Team Check - Don't target teammates
Wall Check - Don't target through walls
Target Part - Choose body part to target
Smoothness - Aim smoothing control
Movement Features
Speed - Movement speed multiplier
Fly - Flight mode
WalkFling - Advanced movement exploit
Noclip - Walk through walls
Misc Features
Full Bright - Remove darkness
Camera FOV - Adjust field of view
Destroy Map - Remove all map objects
Anti-AFK - Prevent AFK kick
UI Features
Custom UI Library - Built-in interface system
Tabbed Interface - Organized feature sections
Draggable Window - Movable key system UI
Visual Feedback - Color-coded responses
